51578500.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CM3 chip-immobilized full-length human galectin-1 assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using CM3 sensor chips. Human galectin-1 (10 μg/mL) was immobilized on the chip surface via amine coupling. The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20, 0.005% Tween 20. Compounds were diluted in running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM. Association was allowed for 120 s, followed by a 300 s dissociation phase. The chip was regenerated with 10 mM glycine, pH 2.0, for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 Evaluation Software v3.0. The dissociation constant (Kd) was calculated from the fitted sensorgrams using a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20, 0.005% Tween 20

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using CM3 sensor chips. 51578502.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CM3 chip-immobilized full-length mouse galectin-1 assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using CM3 sensor chips. Full-length mouse galectin-1 (mGal-1) was immobilized on the chip surface via amine coupling. The immobilization was performed at pH 5.0 using 10 mM sodium acetate buffer. The ligand concentration was 10 μg/mL. The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20, pH 7.4. The analyte (compound 5d) was diluted in the running buffer to concentrations ranging from 0.01 to 100 μM. The association phase lasted 120 seconds, followed by a 120-second dissociation phase. Regeneration was performed with 10 mM glycine-HCl, pH 2.0. Data were collected at 25 °C. The binding curves were analyzed using the Biacore T200 evaluation software. The dissociation constant (Kd) was determined by fitting the data to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20, pH 7.4

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: In Vitro Affinity and Biology Assays. Direct Binding Fluorescence Polarization Experiments Determining Probe Properties with Human and Mouse Galectin-1. A fixed concentration (0.004 μM final concentration) of fluorescein-labeled saccharide probe 9 (in PBS containing 5% DMSO and 0.1 μM BSA) was mixed with a range of galectin concentrations (0.0003–5 μM and 0.0005–10 μM for human and mouse galectin-1, respectively). Fluorescence polarization was measured using an EnVision multimode plate reader with software EnVision Manager version 1.13.3009.1401 (PerkinElmer, Waltham, United States) set for excitation at 480 nm and emission at 535 nm. Kd values were determined using model 353 in the Microsoft Excel add-in XLfit, version 5.5.0.5 (IDBS, Boston, United States). This uses the same equation as previously described16 except that it is not simplified and thus allows for a slope factor other than 1. Competitive Fluorescence Polarization Experiments Determining Galectin Affinities. Fluorescence polarization experiments to measure human and mouse galectin-1 affinities were performed on an EnVision multimode plate reader with the software EnVision Manager version 1.13.3009.1401 (PerkinElmer, Waltham, United States) set for excitation at 480 nm and emission at 535 nm. Kd values were determined by first calculating the IC50 values as previously described.16 From these IC50 values, the Kd values were calculated using the same approach as Wang et al.29 All compounds were dissolved in neat DMSO at 10–20 mM and serially diluted in DMSO to eight different concentrations. From these, the compounds were further diluted (10-fold) in PBS (containing 0.1 μM BSA) and transferred in duplicates to black 96-well plates (Thermo Scientific 237108). Galectin (final concentration 0.02 μM) and probe 9 (final concentration 0.004 μM) were added to the wells in a final total volume of 160 μL. The final concentration of DMSO is 5%. All experimental steps took place at room temperature. After the fluorescence polarization measurements, IC50 and subsequent Kd values were calculated based on the duplicate averages. The standard deviation of Kd values was calculated by using Microsoft Excel. Fluorescence polarization experiments to measure human galectin-3, 4C, 4N, 7, 8C, 8N, 9C, and 9N affinities were performed in principle as previously described.16,5
